name: Ask about maternity insurance coverage
goal: User queries about maternity coverage under Group Mediclaim Policy.
constraints: Bot must route to Group_Mediclaim_Policy, personalize response, use bullet points, caps for key info, source line with doc title and signed URL.

testdata.user_query: What is the maternity coverage amount in our group medical insurance?

phases.description: User asks about maternity insurance coverage.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot does not acknowledge, directly responds with coverage details, uses user's name and designation.

phases.description: Bot formats answer as per instructions.
phases.completionCriteria: Response is under 120 words, uses bullet points, key info in CAPS, includes correct source line with signed URL.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
